dct_description_sm: Contained within the Atlas of Canada's Reference Map Series, 1961 to 2010, is a small scale map of Canada was produced in 1973 and shows Canada's provinces and territories in different colours. The map is at a scale of 1:15 840 000 or 250 miles to the inch and uses the Lambert Conformal Conic projection. Major populated places are shown as well as major roads and railways. Bathymetry is shown in the ocean areas as well as in the North the approximate limit of the permanent polar ice.
